root.label: Air Academy forfeits Lutheran homecoming football game

events.label: Air Academy forfeits Lutheran homecoming football game

slots.name: games cancelled
slots.sentence: All games between Air Academy and Lutheran that were scheduled for this week have been cancelled, including the junior varsity and freshman games.

slots.name: official loss
slots.sentence: While the game has been cancelled and will count as a forfeit loss on Air Academy's record, the remaining homecoming festivities will go on as planned including a flyover, a parachute arrival and a flag football game against The Classical Academy (CO).

slots.name: win loss record
slots.sentence: With the game now counted as an official loss, Air Academy moves to 3-4 on the year.
